reasoning_trace: Traced review text (untrusted model output) into the 1.1.0 CITE regex. The bare `:N` alternative's negative lookbehind rejects only word/path characters and a colon, so `"`, `'`, `}`, `]`, `)` and `*` pass. Every graded review ends with a LOA-VERDICT trailer whose `"counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":7,...}` therefore yields bare citations 0,0,7,0 bound to the last cited path. Reproduced on head with a synthetic manifest: `c.sh:100` + trailer `"medium":7` detects a defect anchored at c.sh:7 (6 citations); `d.sh:300 … {"line":1,"count":2}` detects d.sh:2; an all-zero trailer detects any defect anchored within 0..3 of the last cited file. The base 1.0.0 parser credits none of these (1 citation).
finding: Bare `:N` citation alternative binds JSON values (including every review's own LOA-VERDICT trailer counts) to the last cited file, over-reporting recall in the instrument the Task 4.8 replay A/B rule depends on
critique: A measuring instrument changed by regex needs adversarial inputs drawn from the documents it will score. The header contract (lines 17-21) promises a `:N` glued to a word or number credits nothing, but the implementation only excludes identifier characters.
remediation: Require whitespace, start-of-text, a backtick or an opening paren before the bare colon: replace the empty-lookbehind branch with `(?:^|(?<=[\s`(]))` and extend the lookbehind before `head|base` the same way; add RG cases where the trailer count equals a planted anchor and where inline JSON follows a citation, asserting zero detections; bump grader_version to 1.1.1 and re-run the replay A/B that drove the Task 4.8 revert.

reasoning_trace: The header (lines 17-21) says a `:N` 'with no cited path before it … credits nothing', but `last` is set on the first path citation and never reset, so a bare `:N` thousands of characters later in another section, or in the trailer, still binds to that path. Same root cause as CQ-001; listed separately because the fix (scope `last` to a paragraph or line) is distinct from tightening the lookbehind.
finding: The most-recent-path binding has no scope boundary, so any later bare `:N` anywhere in the review binds to the last path cited
critique: Binding should be local (same line or paragraph) to match the documented contract.
remediation: Reset `last = None` at a blank-line/paragraph boundary (iterate per paragraph) or require the bare `:N` to be on the same line as the path it binds to.

reasoning_trace: The shim runs under `set -euo pipefail` (line 33). A failing mktemp (full or read-only TMPDIR) aborts the script before `error "model-invoke failed …"` and before the exit-code translation, so callers that parse the shim's error line get only mktemp's stderr. `call_flatline_chat` elsewhere guards its mktemp.
finding: Unguarded mktemp under strict mode exits without the shim's own error line or exit-code translation
critique: Error-path additions should keep the existing error contract.
remediation: `err_file=$(mktemp …) || { error "cannot create stderr capture file"; exit 1; }`, and `trap 'rm -f -- "$err_file"' EXIT` so an interrupted hop leaves no temp file.
